name: M. C. Campbell
mentions: …Kansas cattle men. J. R. Blocker, Pugsley Bros., N. Dowling, H. S. Holly, J. W. Driskill, J. T. Lytle, M. C. Campbell and others have been arrested by deputy U. S. Marshal Bell and taken to Dodge City, Kansas. These men have over 50,000 head of cattle on the trail, which are now stopped…
